name: API — the read routes answer and the server refuses bad input safely

steps.text: A NEW GAME starts in the middle of the four plaza buildings, not beside one of them. The four span x 22-28 and y 17-21, so their centre is 25,19 — SPAWN in shared/constants.js. The old start was 24,18, level with the top pair.

steps.label: a fresh save spawns at the centre of the plaza — x

steps.text: FLORINS ARE RARE. A new purse holds 25, not 120 — a florin is now worth about five common materials rather than an eighth of one.

A NEW SAVE CARRIES NOTHING. Bruno: 'I start with many materials that I should not start with: only start with the axe, the pickaxe and 2 tree seeds.' The old crate of salvage existed to unblock crafting the first axe, back when a new save owned no tools; the starter pack made it dead weight.
LEVELS BUY STAMINA. A level-1 save gets the buildings' bonus and nothing more; STAMINA_PER_LEVEL is granted from level 2 up, so a new save is unchanged by the rule.

steps.label: a level-1 save still opens at 110 stamina

steps.text: Bad input must come back as ok:false, never as a 500 and never as a dead server.

steps.label: switching to a nonexistent slot is refused politely
an unknown recipe is refused politely
an unknown route is refused, not crashed into
the server is still alive and serving after all that

steps.text: Any exception handleApi caught and logged would show up in the server-stderr check that runs at the end of every suite.
